question: From which state in India did the legendary volleyball player Jimmy George hail?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jimmy George, hailed as one of India’s greatest volleyball players, was born in **Kerala**.
 
• He was born in **Mavelikkara, Alappuzha District**, Kerala on March 8, 1955.
 
• Jimmy George was the first Indian volleyball player to play professionally overseas, representing clubs in Italy.
 
• He was awarded the **Arjuna Award** in 1976 for his exceptional contributions to Indian volleyball.
 
• Jimmy George passed away in a tragic car accident in **Italy** in 1987, leaving behind a legacy as a pioneer in Indian volleyball.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Volleyball in India:**

 
 
• Volleyball is a popular sport in India, governed by the **Volleyball Federation of India (VFI)**.
 
• India has consistently performed well in volleyball tournaments in Asia, particularly in the **Asian Games**.
 
• The sport gained significant recognition due to players like Jimmy George.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award:**
 
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of India's highest sporting honors, established in 1961.
 
• It recognizes outstanding achievements in national sports and is awarded by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Jimmy George received the award for his exceptional contributions to volleyball in India.
 
 
 
• **Professional Volleyball Career:**
 
 
• Jimmy George represented **India** in several international volleyball tournaments, including the Asian Games.
 
• He played professionally for **Italian clubs**, such as Coletto Club and Treviso, which marked a historic milestone for Indian volleyball.
 
 
 
• **Kerala's Contribution to Sports:**
 
 
• Kerala is renowned for producing exceptional athletes across various sports, including volleyball, athletics, and cricket.
 
• Other notable athletes from Kerala include **P.T. Usha** (track and field) and **Sreesanth** (cricket).
 
• Sports culture in Kerala is deeply rooted, with strong emphasis on nurturing talent at the grassroots level.
